note: UI-DEAD-BUTTONS-001. A <Button> whose label carries an action verb and which has no onClick, type="submit", asChild, href or form, and is not inside a <form> or a trigger wrapper. ANCESTRY IS RESOLVED BY A TAG WALK, not a line window: the unhardened predecessor excluded anything within 15 lines of a form or trigger, which let a submit button declared thirty lines below its form read as dead and let a button merely following a </form> read as alive. Every entry carries a VERDICT and a REASON - wired, deleted, by-design, or unexamined. "unexamined" is permitted and is the point: saying nobody has looked beats implying somebody has, and this list is a WORKLIST rather than settled debt. Round 96 built the guard and resolved two entries; the remaining 93 are product calls about whether each feature should exist, which is the rest of the story. Shrink this list; see scripts/check-dead-buttons.mjs.
